title: Ponderous Luchador
html:
Ponderous Luchador

Ponderous Luchadors will sometimes be encountered in the off dungeons from Level 7 of Mutant Mania. It seems that one of them will usually be found in a group of monsters. They carry a chair just like Manglefeet's, and attack and can be killed as normal monsters. Killing them is the object of the quest Eye of the Liger.

Race: Demi-Humans

Class: Fighter

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Ponderous Luchador ? Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle,Purpose Pondering Peak

Tip: They charge right into battle in the middle of the mobs, but seem very vulnerable. The very first AoE spell or weapon attack will knock them right down. Their chair, while fearsome, does not really do much damage.
